There is a scrunched up cloak worth 3D6 SC at the bottom of the box. Underneath it is a throwing axe.
The box is full of wood shavings, but beneath this are some random metal items roll MIT1 and MIT2.
Some rubbish has been thrown into the box. In it you find some leather cord and some black feathers.
There are 2 twisted metal bars at the bottom and a pouch of seed next to a Lock Pick +1(3).
There is a ruined pack at the bottom of the box. When you look inside you find a throwing dart and a potion. Roll on POT2.
Wrapped in some paper at the bottom of the box is a dead crow. Around its leg is an ornate gold ring worth D6 GC.
table.notes: Notes: Roll 2D6 for this table.

table.title: Level 1 Tables
columns: Tables needed for level 1 of the dungeon.
rows: IAUT1 - Interruptions and the Unexpected - Table 1 - Part 1
IAUT1 - Interruptions and the Unexpected - Table 1 - Part 2
Level 1 Rooms - Human Ancestry - The Entry - Part 1
Level 1 Rooms - Human Ancestry - The Entry - Part 2

table.title: ENP1 - ENCOUNTER PRISONER TABLE 1
table.intro: There is a prisoner here...
rows: Lying face down is a man. He is motionless so you cut the binds on his hands, but he turns and attacks. Face an INFERNAL MONK.
A sickly man is chained to a wall. He begs to be released and you do so, but he is crazed and attacks. Face a LABOURER with no loot.
A shackled prisoner, long dead, hangs from his arms high up on the wall as if a warning of what’s to come.
There is a cell here and inside a person chained up. You approach but see they are slumped forward and realise they are dead.
Bars across a section of the room form a cell. Inside is a slumped body and they have been dead for a while.
There is a bound prisoner here. They look emaciated and are close to death. If you give them a ration they survive. L1PR.
Inside a cage here is a wounded man. If you have some material to bandage the injury, he survives and can escape. L1PR.
A bound woman lays in the dirt. She wakes and looks terrified, the door is locked (lock -2). Pick the lock and she escapes. L1PR.
Shackled to a wall a thin man pleads to be freed and you comply. He runs back the way you came. L1PR.
A man is shackled to the wall here. He pleads for help. You smash the chain and he thanks you and escapes. L1PR.
Two prisoners are trapped in the cell here. You grab the key from the far wall and free them. L2PR.
table.notes: Notes: Roll 2D6 for this table. Liberate 1 prisoner and liberate 2 prisoners are shortened to L1PR and L2PR.

sections.title: IAUT1 - INTERRUPTIONS AND THE UNEXPECTED TABLE 1

table.title: IAUT1 - INTERRUPTIONS AND THE UNEXPECTED TABLE 1
rows: There is a lever beside the far exit. If you decide to pull it roll D6. 1= Nothing happens, 2-3= Any portcullises in the room open, 4-5= All portcullises in adjoining rooms open, 6= The lever snaps. If you have suitable items and can fix it with Inventive Usage, roll again.

At the back of the room is a recess and inside is a small shrine with a miniature statue of a god standing before an offering pan. Roll on GOT1 to identify the god. Only small items may be placed in the pan as offerings and when correctly applied gain 1 FP.

Tucked into a crack in the wall is a small piece of paper that reads ‘the guard Amis stole it’ (Quest for Amis). If you fight a GUARD roll a D6. 1-3= It’s not him, 4-6= It is Amis so you take extra care when searching his body if you win the fight, roll on STIT1.

You cross the room but stagger as the floor falls away from beneath you. You grab for the ledge. Roll 2D6 and add your Precision. On a 7 or higher you grab hold and climb free. On a 6 or lower you fall in and lose 3 health points and then climb out.

There is a box set into the wall here with a makeshift panel door. It is closed and has a rough lock -3. It can be opened with Lock Picks, but not removed from its housing or smashed open. If opened gain 30 XP and roll on CT1.
You begin rummaging through the room when suddenly in barges an unexpected visitor. Roll on L1P and face the enemy. They were carrying something, roll on BT1 -2.

Something that has caught your eye is a stone basin in the corner of the room. It is full of clear water. Above it is a symbol. Roll on SST1. If you can place a related item to the symbol in the water it transforms into a LQ random gem. Roll on GMT1. One use only.

There is a crack in the wall here and inside is a rolled up piece of cloth. It is tricky to remove, so make a precision check PC10(2) to avoid pushing it deeper. If successful, you unravel the cloth and find a Lock Pick +2 (4).

Without realising it you stand on a pressure plate in the middle of the room. If there are any portcullises here, they rise into the ceiling. Otherwise, the next portcullis you encounter is raised, as a distant sound rattles through the dungeon.

Hidden behind a screen at the back is a wooden shrine with a relief carving of a god. There is a slot below the image where a small offering can be placed. Roll on GOT1 to identify the god and when one offering is correctly applied gain 1 FP.

Thrown into a corner is a rag. You hold it up and see the shadowy outline of a god traced on it and realise this is a holy shroud (Holy Shroud Quest). Roll on GOT1 to identify the god. If you place this at a shrine or altar to that god you gain 2 FP for that god.

There is a narrow hole here and you put your hand in to take out a pendant. It has three hollow recesses that appear to have once held gems. You may place three gems in the pendant and roll on GCT1. There may be risks involved.

There is a chest here which you notice has a trap mechanism. You can try to disarm it. Roll 2D6 and add your Precision. If you roll an 8 or higher you succeed and take no damage. On a 7 or lower a blade slices your hand. Lose 2 health points. Inside is a vial of ink and 4D6 +20 SC.

There are some metal objects in a drawer here. One of them is half of an ornate broken item. Roll on HAOIT1 (Ornate Item Quest). If you should find another half of the same item then triple its value, as it magically welds together when connected, and gain 30 XP.

You pull back a crate and find someone has carved out a concealed hollow in the wall. You need to work free two metal bars that prevent access to the hole. Make a Precision check PC8(2) or you give up. If successful gain 20 XP and inside is a bag. Roll on BT1.

On a ledge high up is a golden statue. You can climb for it. If so, you must remain focused. Roll 2D6 and add your Discipline. On a 9 or higher you reach and grab it. On an 8 or lower you fall and lose 1 HP. You can keep trying. The idol is worth 3D6 GC.

There is a dropped silver disc here worth 3D6 +20 SC. It has three indentations where gems can be placed. If you have none now you may try later but if you do place three gems in these slots roll on GCT1. There may be risks involved.

After a careful search you find a concealed door and behind it is a small altar to a god, an image of whom is carved on the wall. There is slot for small items. Roll on GOT1 to identify the god and when offerings are correctly applied gain 1 FP.

There is a lever on the wall here. If you pull it roll D6. 1-2= A pit opens up beneath you and you fall in, lose 2 HP.  3-4= A pit opens up in the next room and you avoid any enemies if any are found there. 5-6= A compartment opens and reveals a box. Roll on CT1.
Mounted on a wall is a large wooden relief showing a god. Roll on GOT1 to identify the god. There are some hooks here on which to hang offerings. Only offerings that can be hung award 1 FP.

Hidden to one side is a body you recognise as a warden from your town. His blue arm band is gone. Add Warden Revenge Quest. If you encounter a GUARD roll D6. 1-3= The GUARD wears a blue arm band and you swing into a rage +1 Shift. Once found, cross off quest and take the band.

You do not notice at first, but when you glance up you see a bag slung over a beam. It is out of reach, but if you have some way of pulling it down through Inventive Usage, then inside you find a couple of items. Roll on POT2 and SCT1.

There is an old rough stone, water filled, basin set in the wall here. Above it is a symbol. Roll on SST1. If you can place a related item in the water it transforms into a MQ random gem. Roll on GMT1.

In the corner of the room there is a wooden panel showing a painting of a god. Roll on GOT1 to identify it. Beneath the panel is a place where offerings can be left, and when applied correctly gain 1 FP.

You spot a stone in the wall that appears out of place. You take a closer look and find it is loose. Behind it is half a cheese wrapped in some cloth. Gain 1 ration. There is also a little dried meat.

There is a chalk board here that reads ‘Krelas the Cleric is delivering the package today’ (Krelas Quest). If you encounter a Dark Cleric roll D6. 1-3= The cleric is Krelas and if you defeat him, you find a package containing a piece of armour on his person. Roll on ART2.

There are some crates in the corner of the room. One is carefully balanced and looks valuable. Make a Precision Check PC9(2) or it tumbles and smashes its contents. If successful gain 20 XP and inside is a Potion of Resist Magic and a Potion of Speed.

A woman runs into the room and says, “Help me, they have my father.” (Father Quest) You explain that it is better that you find him and she leaves. If you release a male prisoner roll D6 1-3= He is her father. Gain 10 GC when you calculate liberated prisoners.

There are several stacked backpacks here that look like raid spoils. As you approach you hold your nose as something is off and the place seems a mess. As if sensing your presence, a HUGE RAT jumps out of the pile and you must fight. Inside the pack there are 4D6 SC in an old pouch.
A box on the wall opens out to show an ornate carved bone shrine. Roll on GOT1 to identify the god. There is a small ledge where you can place small offerings only. When correctly applied gain 1 FP.

You check a space behind a counter and accidentally stand on a pressure plate. A cloud of gas billows forth. Roll 2D6 and add your Precision. If the total is 7 or under then the cloud engulfs you and you lose 3 HP.
You must have been making too much noise for there is a shout and in bursts a foe. Roll on L1P +1 and face the enemy. If you survive you find they were also carrying a bag. Roll on BT1.

You notice beneath your feet a loose stone and when you lift it you find a concealed compartment. It looks just big enough to house a potion in a glass bottle. The metal lid may become jammed though, make a precision check PC8(1). If successful gain 30 XP and roll on POT2.

Tucked to one side is a body. It has been looted apart from a slip of paper with a header that reads ‘Contract,’ and below ‘collect me 5 rats tails’ (Rat Tails Quest). If you collect 5 rat tails you can return this to the exterminator back at the town and collect 5 GC.

There is a tall cabinet standing to one side. Its doors are thick and heavy and as you pull it open it tips over. Roll 2D6 and add your discipline. If you roll over 7 you avoid the falling cabinet. Otherwise it bashes into you and you lose 2 HP.

There is a statue of a god in the corner of the room. Roll on GOT1 to identify it. Beneath the god is a place where offerings can be left and when applied correctly gain 1 FP. There is also a small pouch and casket here. Both are empty.

table.title: L1CE - LEVEL 1 CRATE ENCOUNTERS
rows: A SLIMY GORGER drops from the ceiling, gaining advantage and attacks first
A LABOURER napping out of sight, wakes with a start and attacks.
There’s a hole in a crate and a HUGE RAT jumps out from inside and attacks.
A crate topples over and you ready yourself, but no one is here and you find nothing.
A vase has fallen out of a crate and smashed. Around it are some Ilios petals.
A leather bag has been hidden here behind a crate. Inside is a Potion of Healing.

sections.title: L1LR - LEVEL 1 LARGE ROOMS (32 SQUARES OR LARGER)

table.title: L1LR - LEVEL 1 LARGE ROOMS (32 SQUARES OR LARGER)
table.intro: This space is larger than the average room being 32 squares or larger...
rows: This large space has rough walls and piles of stone laying everywhere. There are the remains of a large stone statue that has been smashed. There is no one here.
There are evenly spaced pillars running along this large marble lined hall, with a round central burner and a metal grill. If you have some wood, you could start a fire.
This room was once a mess hall. Some benches and tables are pushed to one side. Other chairs are stacked around the edges of the room. Roll on IAUT1.
The northeast corner is being used to hold captives. There are whips and knives on table. The floor is covered in bloodied straw. Fight a JAILOR and then roll on ENP1.
In the centre is an ornate fountain bubbling with clear water. It is dedicated to a god and carved in their form. Roll on GOT1. You can make an offering for 1 FP.
Dark murals line the walls. Empty pews form two lines, chandeliers loaded with lit candles hang above. Behind a pulpit stands a figure who attacks. Roll on L1R -1.
This is a training room, where there is a circle of sand in which a WARRIOR and a SCOUT are sparring. They turn and attack. If you survive roll on BT1 +2.
This space is used for storage and crates scatter the space, creating hidden spaces. There is a noise so roll on L1CE, then on MIT2, CT1-2 and BT2-1.
A large slate monolith stands in the centre. Hanging from it is a gold amulet worth 2D6 GC and it has 4 slots. If you have 4 gems you may roll on GCT1.
Lining the walls are bunks and you count enough for twelve men, but most are empty. But, two are occupied. Roll on L1W -1 and L1WO -1. They attack. After, roll on CT2.
Lined with bookshelves, this huge library is protected by two GUARDS. There are also tables covered in scrolls. If you survive roll on SCT1 and SCT2.
table.notes: Notes: Roll 2D6 for this table. If you roll a unique room that already exists on this level then re-roll.

sections.title: LEVEL 1 ROOMS - HUMAN ANCESTRY - THE ENTRY

table.title: LEVEL 1 ROOMS - HUMAN ANCESTRY - THE ENTRY
rows: This room is bare and seems to have been cleared out or forgotten about.
The room is quiet. You hear nothing.
There is a dusty table here upon which sits a dry tankard and an empty wooden bowl.
Beneath the table is a pile of rubbish. Roll on table RUPT1 +1.
A small burner provides warmth for two chairs around a low table. It is lit and casts shadows.
There is someone here. Roll on L1G. If you survive roll on table IAUT1.
Large blocks of stone scatter the space, iron tools and an old hammer lay around.
Roll a D6. 1-4= An ARTISAN is here. You must fight them. If you survive roll on TCT1.
Crates are piled high, creating hidden spaces. Sacks and baskets lean to one side.
Roll a D6. 1-3= A random patrol comes by roll on L1G -1. If you survive roll on TCT1 -1.
Three simple chairs are tucked in around a makeshift wooden table.
Two people stand as you enter. Roll on L1M -1 and L1R -1. If you survive roll on CT1.
There is an anvil on a block, a glowing furnace and walls lined with worn tools.
There is someone here. You must fight the BLACKSMITH. If you survive roll on MIT1.
There is a pile of rubbish here and the floor is covered in scuff marks.
You can check the rubbish pile. Roll on table RUPT1 and then on IAUT1.
An iron barred cell where prisoners are kept is in one corner, a broken chain on the floor.
Roll a D6. 1-4= The JAILOR is here. You must fight them. If you survive roll on ENP1.
There are basins set in worktops here and buckets of soapy water. It is damp here.
Roll a D6. 1-3= A fungal creature emerges. Roll on L1F. If you survive roll on TAT1.
A large fire pit in the centre of the room is full of glowing embers and ash.
There’s a MERCHANT sitting on a stool by the pit. They stand and attack. If you survive roll on CT1.
Kennels line one wall and the floor is littered with bones, water bowls and straw.
A GUARD handler stands and releases a dog. Roll on L1D and then face the GUARD after.
A dusty bowl set into the floor is home to an angry looking snake. It rises up towards you.
To open the chest in the pit you must face a snake roll on L1S. If you survive roll on CT2 -2.
Some crates and barrels hold a range of broken and busted weapons.
You begin to search the space. First roll on IAUT1 and then on MIT2.
Shackles and chains hang from the stone walls, and a cage stands in one corner.
A form moves from the darkness. Roll on table L1WO. If you survive roll on ENP1.
To one side is a wall mounted symbol above a small altar and cushion.
Roll a D6. 1-4= Roll on L1R. After you search the room and if you survive roll on RATT1.
This room has been left empty, the floor swept clean and the walls washed.
The space is silent. There is nobody here.
In a corner two chairs are placed at a burner. The room is warm. On a shelf is a ball of twine.
Someone is sitting by the burner. They attack. Roll on L1W -1. If you survive roll on IAUT1.
This room is bare apart from a small stone shrine set into the wall.
Roll on GOT1 to identify the shrine’s god. When offerings are correctly applied gain 1 FP.
There is a dusty table here upon which sits a dry pewter tankard and an empty bowl.
There is something on the rough table. Roll on table TAT1.
The only feature in this room is a large, tiled bathing pool set into the floor.
In the pool is a chest. If you jump in for it you acquire the soaked status. Roll on CT1.
You see two rows of bunks and some hammocks. There are people here talking.
Roll on L1M-1 twice. If you survive the fight roll on TCT1 as you find a tea chest in a corner.
Empty boxes and tea chests fill this space. There are also sacks and bags.
Roll a D6. 1-4= A random patrol comes by roll on L1P-1. If you survive roll on BT1.
Three rough tables, a few chairs and stools stand next to a wooden bar.
The barman yells and attacks (use LABOURER stats). Also face a patron. Roll on L1W -1.
A stone chamber has been added here. The floor is bloody. Inside lays a corpse on a slab.
There is an ARTISAN here who you must fight. If you survive you find some herbs. Roll on HST1
Behind two curtains, one on each side, are neat wooden framed beds.
Someone jumps up. Roll on L1R. You see a religious carving atop a cupboard. Roll on RATT1.
Part of this room has been sectioned off with wooden bars to create a cell.
Roll D6. 1-4= There is a prisoner here. Roll on ENP1. After roll on IAUT1.
There is a bashed up mannequin and a pole covered in cut marks here.
A WARRIOR is practicing here, slashing at the pole. You must fight them. After roll on IAUT1.
Two large carcasses of unidentifiable animals hang from the ceiling to one side.
A butcher works away at one, turns and attacks, cleaver raised (use ARTISAN stats).
This space has been used to dump rubbish and stone, piles of which fill two corners.
You can rummage through the rubbish. Roll on RUPT1 and then on IAUT1.
A table is covered in jars and bottles. Scrolls full of script are tacked to the walls.
You must face the APOTHECARY. If you survive search the table. Roll on POT1 and POT2.
There is a leak dripping down from above so the space is abandoned and wet.
Fight a fungal creature living here. Roll a D6. 1-3= MUSTY BLOATER, 4-6= FUNGAL GEIST.
There are some metal bars set into the stone floor forming two dirty prison cells.
A JAILOR jumps up. You must face them. If you survive roll on ENP1 -2.
Set high on some shelves are burning candles above a large wooden statue.
A DARK CLERIC stands and attacks. After you can make an offering to Maduva for 1 FP.
This cold stone space is bare and seems to have no function.
There is nobody here or anything of interest.
To one side is a hot stove, some chairs and a large, muddy, hemp rug and a clay tankard.
2 seated people jump up and attack. Roll on L1G-1 and L1M-1. After roll on TCT1+2.

sections.title: L1SR - LEVEL 1 SMALL ROOMS (6 SQUARES OR SMALLER)

table.title: L1SR - LEVEL 1 SMALL ROOMS (6 SQUARES OR SMALLER)
table.intro: This space is too small to be a normal room but it is not a corridor. All exits are archways.
rows: There is nothing in this small space.
This narrow room connects the corridors and has no furniture. On the wall though is some illegible text.
There is a large mural of Grakada here. Her old face smiles at you. If you call for her favour here -2 to the roll. There is no space to make offerings.
There is a large mosaic of Intuneric here, a swirling black visage. If you call for his favour here -2 to the roll. There is no space to make offerings.
There is a rough statue of Maduva here. Its form is twisted sinew. If you call for its favour here -2 to the roll. There is no space to make offerings.
There is a grisly effigy of Murataynie here. It smells of rotting flesh. If you call for its favour here -2 to the roll. There is no space to make offerings.
There is a rope doll of Nevazator hanging here, limp and symbolic. If you call for his favour here -2 to the roll. There is no space to make offerings.
There is a beautiful tapestry of Radacina here, high out of reach. If you call for her favour here -2 to the roll. There is no space to make offerings.
There is a small burner here, that is lit. The space is warm, flickering shadows cast across the space. If you dry yourself roll on L1P. There is nothing else in the room.
In the wall is a small shrine at which you can make an offering, as it has a ledge to place items. It is dedicated to a god, roll on GOT1. Gain 1 FP if applied correctly.
On the wall are two crossed spears and a shield. You take a closer look and see they are for display only and useless. There are some cord and metal strips though.
table.notes: Notes: Roll 2D6 for this table. If you roll a unique room that already exists on this level then re-roll.

blocks.text: The following tables are designed as Creature Cards. These can be referenced here or printed out and made into cards for easy access. You will need to have
access to these cards throughout the game.
The Creature Cards are in alphabetical order for easy reference.
To make these cards into physical cards there are three easy steps.
You will need transparent card sleeves.

table.title: APOTHECARY
table.intro: The apothecary wears breeches and a leather tunic which they open to reveal a collection of vials. Pulling one free they throw it at you as they attack.
rows: Blinding Smoke on Primary 1s and 4s -2 damage Glowing Shield on Secondary 2s -2 damage
[1][5] - GAS CLOUD = D6 -2 + special - you may not attack next turn
One of the vials smashes at your feet but nothing happens. You gain an extra attack.
They retrieve a larger bottle and throw it. Flames burst up around you. Lose D6 HP.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: ARTISAN
table.intro: A skilled worker who has spent many years learning their art. They are not a fighter but are well coordinated and wear sturdy leather work clothes. They will defend their home.
rows: Deflect on Secondary 1s -2 damage Distract on Secondary 6s - 1 damage
They grab up a length of wood, but it is brittle and crumbles in their hand. Gain an extra attack.
The artisan pulls a handful of nails from a pocket and throws them in your face. Take 2 damage.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: BLACKSMITH
table.intro: A hardy artisan, wearing a heavy leather apron, used to hammering metal so they are strong and resistant.
rows: Crossed Arms on Secondary 3s and 6s -2 damage
As the blacksmith attacks They catch their hammer in their apron. You kick out and cause D3 damage.
The blacksmith pulls out a large hook and throws it at you. It catches your arm. Lose D3 HP.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: CRAZED PREACHER
table.intro: Spreading their vile words in amongst the inhabitants of the dungeon, these crazed robed preachers are full of fury. They scream and rush towards you.
rows: The wild preacher becomes caught up in their robes and misses a round of combat.
They jump forward and somehow latch on to you and are able to perform WILD SCRATCH twice.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: CULTIST
table.intro: Serving the religious leaders in the dungeon these worshippers are twisted by hate and set to evil tasks. They wear red robes and face paint, their eyes bulging as they attack.
rows: The Cultist pulls a dagger and throws it but it falls at your feet. You throw it back for 2 damage.
They pull a long chain and fling it at you and wraps around you arm causing 1 damage.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: DARK CLERIC
table.intro: These brooding magic wielders worship Maduva and harness the power of the dead, turning it upon their enemies. They wear textured grey and black cloaks and padded armour.
rows: Dark Magic Haze on Secondary 1s, 2s and 3s - the Dark Cleric heals 1 point of damage if injured and gains one point if not.
The cleric swings his staff but misses and slips from their hands. Gain 1 extra attack.
The air turns cold as the cleric raises their staff. You feel a chill run through you. Lose 2 HP.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: FUNGAL GEIST
table.intro: A squat fungal humanoid, part mushroom part unknown beast. Their appearance can be varied, but they usually have a  wide textured cap and small mushrooms sometimes cover their torso.
rows: The geist attempts a volley of kicks all of which fall short allowing you to prod it hard causing 2 damage.
The geist raises its cap revealing narrow gills from which it fires a series of darts. Lose D3 HP.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: GIANT HORNED ANACONDA
table.intro: A large brown snake with rock like horned ridges, it uses to attack aggressors. They live in rocky environments often near dungeons or caves, where their appearance is perfect camouflage.
rows: Scale block on Secondary 2s and 5s -2 damage
[5][3] - SMOTHER = D6 -2 damage + special attack - miss next round (once per combat).
The snake snaps back and tries to bash you with its head, but instead smashes the wall for D3 damage.
The snake rises high on its tail and swoops down performing  a successful HORN JAB.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: GUARD
table.intro: A trained guard wearing light armour who has some basic skills in combat.  They have duties within the dungeon and can be seen on patrols and at guard posts.
rows: Shield Block on Secondary 3s and 5s -1 damage
The guard lunges carelessly, opens his side and you elbow them hard causing 1 damage.
With an unexpected move the guard disarms you. Lose 1 turn as you grab it back up off the ground.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: GUARD DOG
table.intro: A trained guard dog, appears vicious but has little experience fighting.
rows: The dog skids as it lunges and you are able to get in an extra attack with +1 damage.
The dog thrusts forward and clamps its jaws around your arm causing D3 damage.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: HUGE INFECTED RAT
table.intro: A large grim looking rodent covered in pus-filled blisters that appears to be in a rabid state. Its red eyes bulge as it screeches and attacks.
rows: [4][3] - INFECTED BITE = D6 -3 damage + special - next two turns lose 1 HP
The creature is sickly and seems to cough and spits blood causing it D3 damage.
The rat evades your defence and scurries up your leg and bites your neck using INFECTED BITE.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: HUGE RAT
table.intro: Not a giant but bigger than a normal rat that will savagely attack anything, even larger creatures, when hungry. They are always hungry.
rows: A rat tail without becoming bloodied.
The rat attacks but slips and rolls on its back. You bring down your boot and crush its head, killing it.
The rat pounces and lands on your face. It bites you before you brush it off. Lose 1 HP.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: HUGE SPIDER
table.intro: Not a giant but bigger than a normal spider with a tough carapace and enlarged fangs. It will attack if something breaks its web.
rows: The spider falls as its web breaks and you spin and slice it in two, killing it instantly.
The spider jumps, spins a web, and pings onto your back where it sinks in its fangs. Lose 1 HP.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: INFERNAL MONK
table.intro: Dressed in red leather bands and black clothes the bald monk can call upon Grakada to summon fire that extends from their arm as an infernal whip. It lashes towards you as they attack.
rows: Heat Wave on Primary 2s and 5s -1 damage
Their whip lashes the air and flings back in their face causing them 2 damage.
A second fire whip appears on their other hand and together they strike you. Lose 3 HP.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: JAILOR
table.intro: Being a jailor has made them tough but their skill in combat is limited. As they come forward wrapping a chain around their knuckles, a mad look in their eyes.
rows: The jailor swings but appears tired and falls back on their haunches giving you an extra attack.
With a whip of their fist the chain shoots out and lashes your knuckles. Lose 1 HP if not wearing gloves.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: LABOURER
table.intro: Poorly equipped and unarmed, this labourer offers little challenge, but they have learned patience and do a range of jobs around the dungeon which they will fiercely defend.
rows: The labourer flays wildly and loses their balance. You quickly counter gaining an extra attack.
The labourer barrels past your defence swinging wildly and a punch lands. Take 1 damage.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: MEDIC
table.intro: The nearest thing the dungeon has to a herbalist and medic who looks after the injured but has very little skill. From a bloody apron they pull out a short knife and attack.
rows: Nimble Move on Primary 3s and 4s -1 damage
There must be blood on the medic’s shoes for they lose their footing and fall. Gain 1 extra attack.
The medic whips the apron free, throws it over your head and stabs you causing 2 damage.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: MERCHANT
table.intro: Dressed in fine clothes the merchant manages trade in the dungeon and makes a profit doing so. They pull out a curved sword and prepare to defend their position.
rows: A wallet with D6 GC and D6 SC
Divert Blow on Primary 2s and 5s -1 damage
They try a flurry of complex swings, trip and slash their own leg. They take one damage.
The merchant throws a potion at you that explodes. It causes D3 damage.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: MUSTY BLOATER
table.intro: Animated by primordial magic these swollen fungi shoot hot spores at their victims. They lumber forward, rising up and swelling, from what appears to be flat mould or mildew.
rows: Blinding Spore Cloud on Primary 3s, 4s and 5s -1 damage
The creature seems to lose some of its swell and shrinks for a moment. It misses a round of combat.
Suddenly the Bloater swells, the pressure shooting out a shower of spores. Lose D3 HP.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: SCARLET COBRA
table.intro: A poisonous black snake with scarlet red banding. Lives in deep burrows sometimes finding its way down through cracks in the walls and ceiling of the dungeon.
rows: Darts Aside on Primary 2s and 3s -1 damage
[2][3] - BITE = D6 -3 damage + special attack - poisoned - lose 1 HP per round for 2 rounds.
The snake shoots out its head in an attempted bite, but misses and you’re able to slash it for D3 damage.
The cobra corners coils and whips forward past your defence successfully biting you, see BITE attack.
table.notes: Creature card. LEVEL shows the level box with its circled letter icon.

table.title: SCOUT
rows: Swift Jump on Primary 1s and 6s -2 damage
Usually out of the dungeon scouting the area they strive to avoid combat but are not afraid of a fight. Dressed in green and agile on their feet they thrust the point of a dagger towards you.
The scout tries to grab your weapon but instead twists their wrist and takes 1 damage.
The scout leaps back, pulls out a short bow and looses an arrow. Take D3 damage.

table.title: SLIMY GORGER
rows: Gelatinous Body on Secondary 2s and 6s -2 damage
[4][3] - STICKY SUCTION = D6 -1 damage + special attack - you may not use one random piece of armour this turn.
A dark green slime animated by primordial magic, that lives in wet and cold abandoned spaces. It can rear up and attack with its stretchy gelatinous body.
The slime rises, but cannot take an attacking form and misses a round of combat.
The slime billows out into a wide sheet of green that engulfs you. You struggle free but lose 2 HP.

table.title: SHARD ROCK PYTHON
rows: [4][3] - STRANGLE = D6 -1 damage + special attack - when you attack next round you do one less damage.
A heavy snake, with textured rough skin that is a grey rock colour. It wraps around its victims and strangles the life out of them.
The snake’s slow attack allows you to bash it on the head as it tries to move in closer causing D6 damage.
The python corners you, wraps it’s bulk around your leg causing lose D6 HP.

table.title: THUG
rows: This rough looking brute has few skills and little training and is often deployed as muscle to do unsavoury jobs. They shout abuse as they attack swinging their fists.
The thug tries a combo of swing and uppercut but misses and topples over. Gain 1 extra attack.
The thug manages to grip you and eyes wide they headbutt you hard, take D3 damage.

table.title: VETERAN
rows: Roll on PT1 +1 and an extra D6 GC
Parry on Primary 3s and 4s -2 damage | Armour deflection on Secondary 5s and 6s -1 damage
A strong and experienced old fighter, who used to be a soldier, and knows how to handle themselves. They appear grizzled and slow but can parry efficiently. They sneer as they attack.
The old veteran stumbles and falls. Gain 2 extra hits as he tries to rise.
Out of nowhere the veteran twists and performs a successful CRUSHING BLOW.

table.title: WARRIOR
rows: Bracer block on Primary 4s -1 damage | Dodge on Secondary 3s - 1 damage
A capable warrior trained in the art of combat. They move quickly and appear well equipped. They wear thick metal bracers which they can use to block attacks.
The warrior swings but loses his balance and you kick them hard in the ribs causing D3 damage.
The warrior pulls a small dagger from his boot and flicks it at you. It glances off your cheek. Lose 1 HP.

table.title: WAR HOUND
rows: Raised Legs on Primary 5s and 6s -2 damage
A vicious dog trained to fight. Wears a spiked collar it uses in its charge attack.
The dog seems keen on simply barking in an attempt to scare you and misses the next round.
The dog barrels into you dragging its spiked collar down your thigh causing D6 damage.

table.title: WORK DOG
rows: A working dog with a need to defend its owner, and although not trained to fight still has a savage bite.
The dog flinches and slips as it comes forward afraid of your attack. It hits the wall taking 1 damage.
The dog wrestles through your defence and slashes you with a paw. Lose 1 HP.
